::: {#thm-best-discriminator}

#### The optimal discriminator

For a fixed generator whose points have density $p_g$,
and data with density $p$,
the discriminator that maximizes $V(D, G)$ is

$$
D^*(\vx) = \frac{p(\vx)}{p(\vx) + p_g(\vx)}
$$

@goodfellow2014generative [section 4.1] prove it as their proposition 1.

:::

::: proof
By @sol-best-discriminator.
:::
